verdict.rationale: Reachability of public guidance pages is a fair question for a state regulator's website, so the axis applies. However, both www.scc.virginia.gov and cis.scc.virginia.gov serve robots.txt with "Disallow: /" for all user agents. That bars any compliant, identified agent from the reading surface, and no guidance page was ever shown to be reachable. The Virginia Tax robots.txt belongs to a different agency and was not considered.
